encoding: For each populated source chunk store two packed bitmaps, one for observed positions and one for their labels. Pin block offsets, byte lengths, known counts and SHA-256 digests in the compact preparation receipt. Read and authenticate only requested blocks.

policies.cold: Run the original endpoint-first decision, reading and validating source chunks on demand.
policies.eager: Read smaller saved blocks intersecting any post-start window position, seed the bounds, and scan remaining positions. Skip the seed pass if its announced payload cannot beat the cold full-scan footprint.
policies.guarded: Keep the cold scan order. On its first lookup in a chunk, use saved evidence if the receipt establishes the complete chunk is observed and the saved block is smaller than the source chunk. Otherwise read the source chunk.

criterion: Replay the same 154 shifted-window queries. Verify all decisions against the pinned counts. Compare actual source and saved payload bytes, receipt overhead, and changed-block refusal. The guarded schedule must never use more payload bytes than cold on any query once metadata is loaded.
